/Lotus/Objects/Orokin/Props/CollectibleS.note: Kuria statues are hidden across Grineer and Corpus tilesets. Scan all 56 to unlock the Kuria poem, Emblem, and Orokin Kuria Statuette.

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.note: Lost Islands fragments are scattered across the landscape of Duviri. Scan them to unlock Duviri lore entries.

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriMITWFr.note: Isleweaver fragments are hidden across the Isleweaver archipelago in Duviri.

Somachord Tunes.note: Scan-fragment tones (4 per applicable tileset for most planets/zones, 1 each for Duviri/Isleweaver/Albrecht's Lab) plus quest-tied tones (Veilbreaker, Whispers in the Walls, etc). Exact per-tune spot isn't documented in prose by the wiki. Equip Loot Radar mods (Thief's Wit, Animal Instinct, Loot Detector) to help spot fragments.

Frame Fighter Fragments.note: Spawn randomly within mission tiles on the planet tied to the Warframe(s) they unlock. No fixed spot within the tileset.

Cephalon Fragments.note: Each fragment needs several scans and spawns randomly among a fixed set of possible spots per tileset (no single fixed spot). Spread across most planets. Equip Loot Radar and check side rooms/dead-end tiles.

Leverian Prex Cards.note: One hidden Prex Card per Warframe that has a Leverian exhibit. Exact spots are shown per-item below where known; the rest are somewhere within that Warframe's Leverian exhibit, exact spot not yet documented.

Thousand-Year Fish.note: 20 fragments on the Plains of Eidolon. The wiki documents locations via an interactive map rather than text descriptions.

Fortuna Fragments.note: All in Orb Vallis, organized by narrator (Eudico, Legs/Thursby, Little Duck, Rude Zuud, Smokefinger, The Business, Ticker, and others). Equip Loot Radar and search caves, buildings, and side paths.

The Tenets.note: Obtained by spending a Granum Crown at a Corpus Temple Relief (Parvos Granum fountain altar) in Corpus Ship missions - one Relief per mission, position varies.

Partnership Fragments.note: All on Jupiter, hidden throughout the Corpus Gas City tileset (1 scan each).
